{{Top|leg}}
'''Midnight Leader''' was the callsign used by the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Midnight Squadron]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Palpatine Essex Yerac]] was designated as Midnight Leader.
